name: A re-split share keeps an effective due date and a late fee that follow its creation
title: SC-13-03-20 A re-split share keeps an effective due date and a late fee that follow its creation
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the site is in state F6
Then Oya's share is due on the approval date "2026-11-18" with late fee 1.08 at the reference instant
And Burak's reduced share keeps its effective due date "2026-11-15" and its fee is recalculated on 850.00 to 5.67
